name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Differentiable Rasterizer
definition: A differentiable rasterization method that projects 3D Gaussians to 2D screen space and accumulates color per pixel using alpha compositing, allowing gradients to flow back to Gaussian parameters (position, scale, rotation, opacity, color).
summary: The 3D Gaussian Splatting Differentiable Rasterizer projects 3D Gaussian primitives onto a 2D plane using alpha compositing, enabling gradient flow to Gaussian parameters for differentiable rendering.
